address: 5F, Park Place, 1601 West Nanjing Road, Jingan, Shanghai, China Mainland
bio: The design of the room is a nod to Van Gogh's Almond Blossom; teal cushions and brass trims echo the sky blue background and pinkish flowers of the painting. Peking duck is still the signature here – 45-day-old birds, or 22-day-old ducklings are grilled to perfection and carved tableside. The crispy skin and succulent meat are simply divine. The braised sea cucumber in a gelatinous scallion sauce is another must-try. The city view is a plus....
